scope: measured eligibility disposition; no new rendering optimization

windowSelection.method: draw_attribution.measured_stdout; exclude pre-simulation-marker windows, then four completed post-marker windows

countWeighting: For every retained complete window, recover integer counter sums as round(average-per-frame * 240), then sum. All selected windows have 240 samples. Median window averages are reported separately; medians are not pooled percentiles.

strictAdjacentMergeUpperBound.meaning: Necessary identical object/shared-state pairs only; topology, stencil and pass barriers further restrict this set. Frequency bound is not a CPU/GPU time or native-driver draw-call savings bound.

barriers: QuadStrip concatenation can connect otherwise independent trails
Primitive topology, pose, palette, billboard/viewmodel, diffuse, lights and exact material/raster state must stay compatible
Native per-item/pass order and inherited final attributes must be preserved

historicalStream.observation: About 422 -> 407 FPS unprofiled; world CPU p99 1.465375 -> 1.547604 ms profiled
historicalStream.action: Existing unchanged experiment was not repeated; stays opt-in

limits: Existing reused preparation counts are not additional work savings
No new per-pass/type/stencil eligible-run or order witness is claimed
Inclusive owner geometry wall includes driver/backpressure and is not isolated GPU time
No universal absence of opportunities is inferred from one fixture
User paths, machine name, PID and raw game assets are omitted
